programme.desc: Chris Evans sliter med å holde lunsjen nede mens han rir med Sabine Schmitz i den nye Audi R8. I mellomtiden får Matt LeBlanc en kort valgturné i London.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 4
programme.desc: Chris, Matt og Sabine kjøper billige, brukte biler og drar til Venezia. Målet? For å bevise at å reise med bil kan være mer luksuriøst enn å ta toget.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 5
programme.desc: Chris Harris gjenskaper med den nye BMW M2 og Rory Reid en historisk reise mot klokken, for å levere Jaguar F-type SVR til Geneva Motor Show.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1103
programme.desc: Janni skal gjøre en viktig og avgjørende undersøkelse av lungene, som hun er veldig nervøs over. Tina skal gifte seg igjen og har bestemt seg for å finne den perfekte brudekjolen ved hjelp av Jackie og Gunnvør.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1104
programme.desc: Tina og familien hennes har dratt til Ibiza for å fornye hennes og Allans bryllupsløfter. Hjemme står Jackie i et stort dilemma angående den kommende mageoperasjonen.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1105
programme.desc: Karina, Janni, Jackie, Gunnvør og Tina drar på jentetur til den vakre byen Venezia. Venezia viser seg imidlertid å være litt vanskelig å manøvrere i, og noen av fruene ender opp med å gå seg vill.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1106
programme.desc: Mens de andre damene koser seg i Italia, blir Amalie med moren Lotte på et deilig slottsopphold hjemme i Danmark. Amalies to døtre Josephine og Hannah er også med, men det byr på noen utfordringer.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1107
programme.desc: Tinas nye hjem blir utsatt for innbrudd. Amalie og Karina drar til et holistisk retreat for å gi slipp på dårlige energier.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2907
programme.desc: Peter og Mathilda har vært sammen i over tjue år og har to barn sammen, men nå eksisterer deres forhold bare gjennom det de sammen skylder bankene.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2908
programme.desc: Mikael har alltid forvaltet økonomien sin dårlig. Utad har han levd som om han ikke har noen problemer, og det var bildet han formidlet da han møtte kjæresten Emelie.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2909
programme.desc: Christian er kokken som har levd det gode livet på restauranten i over tjue år og sakte men sikkert har pådratt seg stor gjeld.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3001
programme.desc: Alenemoren Malin er i så store problemer at hennes eks forrige måned måtte overføre penger slik at hun hadde råd til mat og bleier. Nå er hun uten jobb og aner ikke hvordan hun skal kunne betale husleien neste måned.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 3002
programme.desc: 33 år gamle Viktoria i Norrköping har aldri hatt en heltidsjobb, men det hindrer henne ikke i å kjøpe ting på avbetaling, som hun så ignorerer å betale.

programme.title: I'm Not There
programme.desc: I'M NOT THERE er en ukonvensjonell reise gjennom Bob Dylans liv og musikk. Filmen beskriver Dylans mange sider og identiteter. I en serie sammenvevde historier portretterer seks forskjellige skuespillere Dylan i ulike tidsepoker.

programme.title: Just my Luck
programme.desc: Lindsay Lohan er strålende somAshley, Manhattans heldigste jente. Men hun aner ikke atlykken skal til å snu seg.Når hun kysser ulykkesfuglen Jake på en fest.

programme.title: William Shakespeare's A Midsummer Night's Dream
programme.desc: Både Demetrius og Lysander er ville etter vakre Hermia. Hermia blir tvunget til å gifte seg med Demetrius, men hun elsker Lysander. De planlegger å stikke av sammen og…

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The Collector
programme.desc: THE COLLECTOR følger opp historien til håndverkeren Arkin, som gjør absolutt alt han kan og mer til for å betale gjelden til sin eks-kone ved å rane hjemmet til sin nye oppdragsgiver.

programme.title: Impact Earth
programme.desc: En astronomiprofessor med NASA-bakgrunn gjør en skremmende oppdagelse om at en destruktiv asteroide er på kollisjonskurs med jorda, og han må få familien i trygghet mens han varsler verden om den kommende ødeleggelsen.

programme.title: Proxima
programme.desc: Astronauten Sarah forbereder seg til et års langt oppdrag på Den Internasjonale Romstasjonen. I det siste oppdraget før ferden til mars, er det mye som står på spill, ikke minst privat. Eva Green spiller hovedrollen som Astronauten Sarah Loreau.

programme.title: Wild Rose
programme.desc: En ung Glasgow-jente drømmer om å bli countrystjerne i Nashville.

programme.title: My Neighbor Adolf
programme.desc: Sør-Amerika, 1960. En ensom og gretten Holocaust-overlevende overbeviser seg selv om at hans nye nabo er Adolf Hitler i egen person. Ingen tar ham alvorlig, så han innleder sin egen etterforskning for å bevise påstanden

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Bud Spencer er Banana Joe, en vennlig kjempe av en banandyrker som bor i en liten Søramerikansk by. Det går livet sin vante gang helt til et stort selskap vil ta over bananplantasjen og sette Joe i fengsel.

programme.title: Games People Play: The Way You Save
programme.desc: Kareem sier til Marcus at han ikke kan leve i skyggen av ham, og ber ham kjøpe ham ut så han kan gå videre. Marcus gir ham 250 000 med sin velsignelse. Kareem og Quanisha går til Jamal med en sekk penger for å betale så han skal dra.

programme.title: Boomerang: Don't Wanna Love You
programme.desc: Påvirkningens krefter utforsker når influereren Tia får en velbetalt en-kvelds gig på en strippeklubb. Samtidig blir David påvirket av en ny megakirke.

programme.title: Boomerang: Reversal Of a Dog
programme.desc: Bryson får den ikke opp og passerer de akseptable grensene for mannlig intimitet når han prøver å snakke om det hos barbereren; Ari vurderer grensene for hans seksualitet og maskulinitet, og utfordrer hans selvfølelse.

programme.title: Boomerang: Day Weekend
programme.desc: Simone samler gjengen og særskilte andre på farens luksusstrandhus. Det skulle føre alle sammen, men slutter med å vise hvordan alle har forandret seg og muligens vokst fra hverandre.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Freedom
programme.desc: Mary Jane lover på å nyte en angstfri helg, men planen skjærer seg når Mark ber henne om hjelp med foreldrene som er på besøk. Åpenbaringer tvinger Mark til å forandre.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Mary Jane Knows Best
programme.desc: Da Mary Janes affære ble avslørt, tvinges hun til å innse at hun er mer hekta enn hun trodde. Patricks nykterhetsfest gir et bilde av den mannen han engang var.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Sleepless In Atlanta
programme.desc: Kara vil beskytte Mary Jane fra resultatet av en fokusgruppe, Niecy prøver å verne seg seg og Treyvion for faren hans, som uventet dukker opp fra college. Patrick prøver å balansere arbeid og familie, og Mary Jane treffer Sheldon.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 401
programme.desc: Dr. Martin Ellingham og Louisa har tatt den hjerteskjærende avgjørelsen om å avlyse bryllupet deres.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 402
programme.desc: Dr Martin Ellingham sliter med å takle Louisas nyheter. Men Louisa er fast bestemt på at hun ikke vil at Martin skal være involvert.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 403
programme.desc: Dr. Martin Ellingham er overrasket over å finne Louise og Joan utenfor døren før åpningstid. Louisa er bekymret for at noe er galt og vil ha Martins bekreftelse på at alt er i orden.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Music Case
programme.desc: In 1999, a 12-year-old was found murdered in her Minnesota home. Despite a meticulous search of the home and an exhaustive investigation, police had no suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Paintball
programme.desc: In 1962, the small town residents of Hanford, California lost their sense of peace when one of their own, 15-year-old Marlene Miller, was murdered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign Here
programme.desc: A mother of two vanishes after a shopping trip. Her body is discovered a month later, and witnesses say they saw the victim being forced into a car by an unknown person.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shadow of a Doubt
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi: a timestamped videotape of his activities on the day of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tourist Trap
programme.desc: In 1993, the state of Florida was known for more than just Disney World. Worldwide attention focused on a rash of robberies which targeted tourists. Some vacationers were killed in these attacks, but some fought and survived.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Once Bitten
programme.desc: Investigators find a shoe print, several foreign hairs and unknown fingerprints at a murder scene. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim's chest.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All Wet
programme.desc: A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina. Faced with striking similarities, examiners must determine if their suspect's story about accidental drowning is all wet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shot of Vengeance
programme.desc: A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors are able to discover the cause, until she visits her gynecologist for a routine check-up.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dinner and a Movie
programme.desc: Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom. A striking similarity between her death and an HBO movie gives examiners the clues they need to thaw out the alibi of a cold-blooded killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Wrong Foot
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker, but one simple clue helped track the footsteps of a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Order Up
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal. An endocrinologist, a forensic botanist and a short-order cook answer their question.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Temple of Fear
programme.desc: In Miami, the discovery of a mutilated body sent investigators on the trail of a deadly cult. But agents found a wall of silence around the cult's members. Potential witnesses, terrified of reprisals, refused to talk.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Mercy
programme.desc: Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.

programme.title: The FBI Files: No Remorse
programme.desc: A burning body in a dark alley shed light on a cold-blooded killer. His partners in crime would tell the story, if they lived. In the underworld of the drug trade, even a childhood friend can quickly become an enemy.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Target
programme.desc: Over a thousand hunting accidents are reported in the United States each year. Fewer than ten percent of them are fatal. But when one hunter's death seemed suspicious, the FBI was called in to investigate.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid, the box exploded, killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Remnant of Blame
programme.desc: The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shreds of Evidence
programme.desc: Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Blood
programme.desc: A army vet is found bleeding to death on the asphalt of a parking lot -- his chest littered with too many knife wounds to count. Kenda’s case is stuck in first gear until a gruesome clue appears.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The End
programme.desc: Kenda faces his most difficult case yet – the slaying of a young boy. The detective makes the most consequential decision of his career.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: When the Music Stops
programme.desc: Vietnam War veteran Charles Walker is found unconscious, after a stabbing attack so savage even 45 units of blood couldn’t save his life.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Monster Awakes
programme.desc: When Julie Smith reports being sexually assaulted, Lt. Joe Kenda and his Sex Crimes Unit discover a terrifying similarity to other attacks on the east side of town.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Last Fare
programme.desc: A young man is found dead behind the wheel of his taxi. With robbery seeming unlikely, Kenda and Gaenzle wonder if this was personal.

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: From There to Here
programme.desc: The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies. In them, we can read not only our origin, but also our final destination. Technology is on the brink of taking us to places we have only dreamed of.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Return to the Moon
programme.desc: The moon is our closest celestial companion. It lights our night sky and gently tugs at our shores. Few have walked on her surface, but her allure remains strong.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Planet Makers
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our solar system 4.5 billions years ago, there remain many clues to reveal its evolution. Remnant debris, asteroids, and comets are what's left of the building blocks to our celestial neighborhood.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Gas Giants
programme.desc: In the cold, dark expanse of our solar system, beyond the asteroid belt, lie the giant planets. Some can be seen with the naked eye, others have been visited by our camera. What secrets do they hold?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.title: Ice Cold Killers: Silent Night

programme.title: Ice Cold Killers: Ice Cold Heart

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Things Come in Threes
programme.desc: When two young mothers are gunned down behind a crowded bar, Kenda has to first determine who was the intended target and who was collateral damage.

programme.title: Ice Cold Killers: Frozen Innocence
programme.desc: On a chilly morning in St. Louis, an 11 year old girl vanishes. Days later her body is found along an icy river bank. It’s a race against time for investigators who fear the killer will strike again.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Snitch
programme.desc: When officers respond to a shooting , they discover the body of a young man they know all to well -- police informant Jimmie Stevenson. it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda to determine who pulled the trigger.

programme.desc: I mai 2017 ble småbarnsfaren Filip Viking funnet skutt i Katrineholm. Vitner skynder seg bort til ham og i forbindelse med forsøkene på å redde Filips liv, klarer de å se en lang svartkledd mann løpe fra åstedet.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 301
programme.desc: Justisminister Tor Mikkel Wara blir i 2018 utsatt for en rekke alvorlige angrep på sitt private hjem. I flere måneder står politiet uten spor, helt til det kommer et sjokkerende gjennombrudd i saken.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 302
programme.desc: I september 2003 blir en gutt seksuelt misbrukt av en mann i trappeoppgangen der han bor. Politiet starter en intens jakt på mannens identitet for å få stoppet ham. Samtidig kommer det stadig inn nye meldinger om overgrep.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 303
programme.desc: Tidlig på 90-tallet rystes den norske befolkningen av flere kirkebranner. I 1993 blir Øystein Aarseth funnet død i en trappeoppgang i Oslo. Politiet retter søkelyset mot enkelte personer i black-metal-miljøet. En av disse er Varg Vikernes.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Episode 304
programme.desc: I august 2004 stormer to bevæpnede personer inn i Munch-museet på Tøyen. I kaoset som oppstår tar de med seg de to verdenskjente maleriene Skrik og Madonna. Hvem står bak tyveriet, og er bildene tapt for alltid?
